This directly impacts the structure and support for healthcare providers, particularly those in areas that might otherwise struggle to provide services.

By extending a federal program for several fiscal years, the bill implicitly continues or increases government expenditure related to supporting healthcare providers, particularly in rural and underserved areas. While the exact amount isn't specified, extending a program implies continued spending.

The entire bill extends the Quality Payment Program-Small Practice, Underserved, and Rural Support program under Medicare (title XVIII of the Social Security Act) for fiscal years 2026-2031, providing ongoing federal technical assistance and support to small/rural/underserved practices. This is a direct continuation of government involvement in healthcare delivery and access.
